title: Plug Command
description: A one-shot instruction Core drops into a Plugin's Outbox to actuate a Smart Plug's relay right now. See CONTEXT.md: Command, Outbox; ADR 0014.

plugin.description: The Plugin that should execute this Command, e.g. "tuya_lan" — matches plug.plugin. Only a Plugin that implements command execution ever reads its Outbox directory at all; govee_ble never does.

external_id.description: The opaque per-Plugin device id this Command targets — matches plug.external_id for the same plugin. See CONTEXT.md: External ID.

command.description: The instruction kind. Only one exists today — see CONTEXT.md: Command. Room to add more later (e.g. a future automation phase) without changing this envelope's shape.

requested_at.description: UTC timestamp the Command was issued, formatted exactly like SQLite's datetime('now') — "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS", no 'T', no timezone suffix — so it compares directly against plug_last_seen/plug_state_transition when deciding whether a Command has been confirmed yet (see ADR 0014).

request_id.description: The originating plug_command_log row's id, carried along for tracing/log correlation only — a Plugin never needs to interpret it, just echo it in its own log lines if useful.
